note: Both spellings, at top level in the current buffer with no local binding anywhere: `setq-default' writes the default and `setq-local' creates a binding in this buffer, and reading each name back answers what was written. Emacs answers the same two values, and since Phase 18 it answers them for the same reasons -- which is what makes this case comparable at all. Its note used to say kg had no buffer-local variable namespace and that the agreement was a coincidence.
